run_pybullet_deformable_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation with a deformable world, gravity, and a soft body bunny mesh
create_pybullet_soft_body: create a pybullet soft body from an OBJ file with mass spring, bending springs, and face contact settings
load_pybullet_urdf_objects: load URDF plane and cube objects into a pybullet physics simulation with maximal coordinates
configure_pybullet_time_step: configure the pybullet physics simulation time step and enable real-time simulation mode
test_pybullet_gravity_simulation: test a pybullet simulation loop that applies gravity each frame while connected to the GUI
